case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the cost movements and their weightings. We recognise that these inputs have risen; our analysis nevertheless supports the lower framework pricing proposed below.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

A multi-year agreement offers volume visibility, while keeping the arrangement straightforward respects your standard-range policy. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your proposed terms; which package works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

We look forward to agreeing clear commercial and supply terms that work within your account policy.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. We appreciate your proposal and welcome the shift to a 24-month agreement for better planning visibility. While we note your updated demand forecast, our pricing must remain sustainable given the cost factors we previously shared. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative option, we can therefore offer €4.88 per unit for a 24-month term while maintaining the 30 days net payment terms. Specifically, this alternative is a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for reducing your price and offering an alternative on your standard payment terms. We recognise your need for sustainable standard-range pricing based on the cost drivers you identified.

We have raised our offer modestly and expect a further price step in return. We are flexible on contract length; the longer option offers more planning visibility to support the binding volume arrangement you requested, so please indicate which works best. We can commit to over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.52 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.52 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

Which volume or contract length would let you improve the price further?

We appreciate your constructive response and would welcome a straightforward agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer, but the modest increase does not enable us to lower our price. We must therefore hold our offer at €4.94 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days net payment. 

You mentioned a binding volume arrangement; please provide the exact volume figures you can commit to, though longer contract terms will not improve the price further. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. For full transparency, our Angebot features a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

We recognise that our modest increase has not changed your price and that a longer term brings no further reduction. Thank you for clarifying that higher binding volume can support better pricing.

We have raised our price proposal again and expect a concession in return, linked to an agreed binding volume rather than contract length alone. We remain flexible on contract length; please indicate which option works best for the volume arrangement you requested.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.58 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.58 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 90 days net.

We appreciate your help in defining a straightforward framework arrangement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised proposal, but without the specific binding volume figures we requested, we cannot adjust our pricing. Consequently, we must maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days net payment. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Please provide the exact volume you intend to commit to so we can properly evaluate the commercial terms. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

To summarize our Angebot, we require a contract term of 24 months, a price of €4.94 per unit, and a Zahlungsziel 90 days net. This offer stays valid for 7 days. We value you as a customer and look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
